ideal: A one-line alert: Apple filed an amended current-events report (8-K/A, item 5.02) about its executives or directors joining, leaving or being paid. The report doesn't say what changed. Include the link.

verdicts.note: It explains item 5.02 correctly in plain words, admits the report doesn't show what changed, and links the filing, though it is slightly wordy.
verdicts.answer: Apple filed an amended 8-K (an update to an earlier current-events report). It falls under item 5.02, which covers executives or board members joining or leaving, or how they're paid. The report doesn't show what changed. Filing: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000114036126035325/ef20081427_8ka.htm

verdicts.note: It is concise and accurate and names the filing in plain words, but gives a little less context on what item 5.02 covers.
verdicts.answer: Apple: amended current-events report (8-K/A) on its officers or directors (item 5.02) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000114036126035325/ef20081427_8ka.htm

It leaves out the item, and it misuses the 'no filing explains it yet' phrase, which is meant for unexplained price moves, so the message is confusing.

verdicts.answer:
Apple filed an amended current-events report (8-K/A, item 5.02 — typically departure of directors or certain control changes) on 2026-09-01.
